description: Get an event's details, participants and time options with per-option vote tallies and who voted. Identify the event with the token from the personal link (the last part of /e/{token}): an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token. Also returns your_response per option.

event_id.description: Optional event ID; if given it must match the token's event. Not needed: the token identifies the event.

token.description: The token from a personal link (the last part of /e/{token}). May be either an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token; the server works out which.

name: get_event
